text: Hey folks, does anyone know the process for getting a second laptop? I need to test some stuff on Windows and my main machine is Mac. Couldn't find anything in the handbook about this.

Hi Chloe! Yeah, it's not in the handbook yet, but the current practice is you can request a second device for cross-OS testing if your manager signs off. You just need to fill out the 'Additional Hardware Request' form (it’s in the IT portal, under Equipment Requests) and attach a quick note from your manager explaining the need.
Awesome, thanks Priya! Is there a budget cap or anything I should know before I ask my manager?

Good question! For testing purposes, the cap is usually $1200 USD for the second device. IT will suggest a model that fits your needs and budget. Just make sure your manager’s note mentions it’s for cross-platform testing.
Perfect, that helps a lot. I’ll ping my manager and get the form started. Thanks again!
